Undergraduate programme

B.Sc Bachelor of Science

Pursue specializations across science and emerging technology fields.

  • 3 years
  • Science & Technology
  • No attendance
Ask about eligibility

What the B.Sc covers

Level
Undergraduate (UG)
Duration
3 years
Field
Science & Technology
Study format
Distance / online, no attendance

Who can apply

Class 12 (or an equivalent recognized qualification). Students who left an earlier degree partway may be eligible for credit transfer into a later year.

If you left an earlier degree partway, read how credit transfer works for completed semesters.

How you study

Distance and online learning, with no attendance requirement and no fixed class hours, so the programme runs alongside full-time work.

For a realistic picture of the weekly hours, see finishing a degree while working full time.

What you study

The core of a B.Sc. Exact papers and electives are set by the awarding university.

  • Core science specialisation
  • Mathematics
  • Statistics
  • Laboratory and practical work
  • Research method
  • Computer applications

Where it leads

People in technical work who need the formal science degree their next role or exam requires.

  • Technical and laboratory roles
  • Government science posts
  • Teaching after B.Ed
  • Further study: MSc

Admission process

  1. 1Free counselling call to confirm eligibility and the right programme
  2. 2Document check ID, previous marksheets and any earlier degree transcripts
  3. 3University application prepared and submitted on your behalf
  4. 4Confirmation of admission and enrolment, with fee instalments arranged

The awarding university, its recognition status and the fee for a given intake are confirmed in writing during counselling, since they vary by programme and academic year.
